en: Fwahahaha! A mere child dares to challenge me? I am Koga, Leader of this Gym!
Ninja arts are the arts of deception. My poisons will sap your strength while you stumble in confusion!
Hmph! You have proven your worth. Take the Soul Badge.
{player} received the Soul Badge from Koga!
With the Soul Badge, your Pokémon can use Surf outside of battle, to ride across the water.
Take this as well. It is the very essence of my art.
TM06 is Toxic. It poisons the foe badly, and the poison grows worse with every turn.
You have the makings of a fine trainer. Remember: when strength fails, cunning wins the day.
Hey, champ in the making! This Gym is full of walls you can't see.
Koga's Pokémon use poison and every trick in the book. Bring something to cure poison, and feel your way along!
You found your way through the invisible walls and beat Koga! What a ninja you'd make!
Fuchsia City Pokémon Gym. Leader: Koga. Winning trainers: {rival}.
Fuchsia City Pokémon Gym. Leader: Koga. Winning trainers: {rival}, {player}.
